entries.title: Fixed Upright Hub and Radial Tine Arm Rake
entries.description: One newly authored complete single upright-axis rotary-rake-style farm implement exterior. Two small low wheels and a full low forward draw frame support a vertical central pedestal and shallow drum. Seven whole long radial carrier arms extend horizontally from this hub; each ends in a full short transverse bar with two complete downward curved blunt tines. A finite front parking foot holds the fixed empty display. The circular horizontal arm organization and low undercarriage differ from the old high-wheel transverse parallel comb and from the horizontal rotor claws under a compact walkbehind engine. Every visible coordinate is new, no old wheel, tooth array or machine subassembly imported. One static model zero scenes. No rotation, gear drive, spring action, raking, hay processing, towing, hitch fit, working clearance, fabrication, load or safety claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
